title: FunnyDeathMessages
description: Custom funny death messages with MiniMessage formatting
body:
Tired of boring death messages? FunnyDeathMessages replaces them with hilarious, customizable messages!

## Features
- Different message pools for fall, drowning, fire/lava, PvP, mob kills
- Placeholders: {player}, {killer}, {mob}
- Full MiniMessage support (colors, gradients, bold)
- 100% configurable via config.yml
- Reload command: /deathmsgs reload

## Permissions
- `funnydeaths.reload` - Access to reload command

Perfect for SMPs, survival servers, and any server that wants more personality!
